metadata.description: Data engineering agent that creates, extends, and explores dlt data pipelines

plugins.name: init
plugins.description: Shared base for the lean workbench: the agent's identity (SOUL) and toolkit routing index, installed as always-on context. A dependency of every toolkit.

plugins.name: rest-api-pipeline
plugins.description: Build a dlt pipeline that loads data from a REST API or HTTP endpoint (Stripe, GitHub, Salesforce, HubSpot, any web service).

plugins.name: sql-database-pipeline
plugins.description: Build a dlt pipeline that loads tables from a SQL database (Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, any SQLAlchemy-supported database).

plugins.name: filesystem-pipeline
plugins.description: Build a dlt pipeline that loads files (CSV, Parquet, JSONL) from local disk, S3, GCS, Azure, or SFTP into a destination.
